notes.title: Lost Worlds: The Saved Games I ve Abandoned
notes.content:
These are my personal Edwin Droods. Stories that I’ve failed to finish, for one reason or another, and that are left suspended. In the manner of somebody reversing out of a relationship like a heavy goods vehicle, trundling slowly and beeping nonchalantly, I’d like to say to the games included: It’s not you, it’s me.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Big Update is Live. Full Controller Support, Bug Fixes and More!
notes.content:
Full controller support is now available - including D-Pad navigation in the Menus. 

Look sensitivity controls have also been added -effecting both keyboard and controller. 

Keyboard input issues resolved. 
Apologies to the few of you who were experiencing keyboard input issues. 
It was due to a V-Sync / Unity conflict which should now be resolved.

Additionally, numerous small gameplay improvements have been made as well.

Happy "Ritualing"!

-the zemaGamez team

notes.title: Rules and Guidelines for the zemaGamez Forum
notes.content:
Hi everyone, and welcome. 

We've created this forum as the primary point of communication for our game to gather feedback from the community. 

During its time in Early Access, we will be monitoring the boards closely and responding to as many suggestions and bug reports as possible to ensure an open dialogue and to make the finished product the best it can be. 

We want this to be a positive, creative and welcoming space so please be respectful of the rules and help keep this a respectable place. 

Rules and Guidelines – Please refrain from the following:

• Insulting other members – c'mon be cool to one another.
• Posting personally identifiable information (names, address, email, phone    numbers, etc.)
• Bumping threads
• Derailing a thread's topic
• Posting links to phishing sites
• Posting inappropriate links, pornographic images, phishing sites, racist, sexist, homophobic,  discriminatiory or offensive content
• Post spam or Re-post Closed, Modified, Deleted Content
• Arguing with a moderator
• Discussing, hacks, cheats, or piracy will result in a permanent ban 
• Posting threats of violence or harassment
• Posting copyrighted materials 
• Soliciting or advertising of any kind 
• Abusive language, including swearing

NOTE: Warnings, bans, and lifetime bans are all at the discretion of zemaGamez.
